title: Generic UE configuration update procedure initiated by the network

entities.name: Generic UE configuration update procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by AMF to update UE configuration parameters. AMF sends CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message to UE with various parameters or indications.

entities.name: CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent by AMF to UE to initiate configuration update procedure. Contains various IEs for parameter updates or registration requests.

entities.name: Configuration update indication
entities.description: IE containing Registration requested bit and Acknowledgement bit. Used to request UE registration or acknowledgement.

entities.name: Allowed NSSAI
entities.description: IE containing allowed network slice selection assistance information. Updated during configuration procedure.

entities.name: Rejected NSSAI
entities.description: IE containing rejected network slices. Can be in Rejected NSSAI IE or Extended rejected NSSAI IE based on UE capability.

entities.name: Extended rejected NSSAI
entities.description: IE for rejected network slices when UE supports extended rejected NSSAI capability.

entities.name: CAG information list
entities.description: IE containing Closed Access Group information. Can be in CAG information list IE or Extended CAG information list IE.

entities.name: 5GS registration result
entities.description: IE indicating registration status, including "Registered for emergency services" value.

entities.name: Additional configuration indication
entities.description: IE containing Signalling connection maintain request bit to indicate if N1 NAS signalling connection release is required.

entities.name: T3555
entities.description: Timer started by AMF when acknowledgement is requested from UE in CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message.

entities.name: 5GMM-CONNECTED
entities.description: 5GMM connected state where UE has active NAS signalling connection with network.

entities.name: Acknowledgement requested
entities.description: Condition where AMF requests acknowledgement from UE by setting Acknowledgement bit in Configuration update indication IE.

entities.name: Registration requested
entities.description: Condition where AMF requests UE to initiate registration procedure by setting Registration requested bit in Configuration update indication IE.

entities.name: UE supports extended rejected NSSAI
entities.description: UE capability to support extended rejected NSSAI IE format.

relations.description: AMF initiates generic UE configuration update procedure by sending CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message.
CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message contains Configuration update indication IE.
CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message may contain Allowed NSSAI IE.
CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message may contain Rejected NSSAI IE.
CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message may contain Extended rejected NSSAI IE when UE supports it.
CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message may contain CAG information list IE.
CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message may contain 5GS registration result IE.
CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message may contain Additional configuration indication IE.
When acknowledgement is requested, AMF starts timer T3555.
Configuration update indication IE guards registration requested condition via Registration requested bit.
Configuration update indication IE guards acknowledgement requested condition via Acknowledgement bit.
If UE supports extended rejected NSSAI, rejected S-NSSAIs are included in Extended rejected NSSAI IE.
Generic UE configuration update procedure can be performed when UE is in 5GMM-CONNECTED state.
